overview: The period features weak-lensing benchmarks and field-level inference, Euclid DR1 strong-lens catalogues, and radio weak-lensing forward modelling. Gravitational-wave work applies CNNs for early warning and neural-guided sampling for EMRIs. LLM pipelines extract dark-matter models and galaxy discussions from arXiv, while differentiable galpy backends and JAX Gaussian-process inference provide reusable tooling.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens catalogues and pipelines
LLM literature extraction and model registries
